text:
Nina R.: Postmortem follow-up for Kepler dedicated incident. Short: customer edge route churn during nightly backup + our isolation controller flagged transient route changes -> wide tenant isolation; impact ~3.5h. Need owners, short ETAs, and recurrence detection.

Nina R.: Proposed action items:
• Peering hardening (per-peer dampening, selective keepalive bump) — owner/ETA?
• Isolation controller patch (short debounce, origin-AS verification) — owner/ETA?
• Canary runbook + synthetic /24 test before prod rollout — owner/ETA?
• Alerting: route-flap -> auto-ticket + page for high-risk customers — owner/ETA?

Owen P.: I can take peering hardening. Plan: add per-peer dampening, keepalive only for Kepler neighbors, prefix ACL. ETA: design + staging in 6 business days, rollout in 12.

Maya S.: I'll own the isolation controller fix. Plan: 20s debounce on withdraws, require origin-AS match for 45s, emit metrics for isolation_decision. ETA: hotfix PR in 3 business days, canary in 8.

rdw-bot: Created Jira tickets RDW-3050 (kepler-peering-harden) and RDW-3051 (isolation-controller-debounce). Links: https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-3050 , https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-3051

Ravi (runtime): Ill build the canary harness and smoke checks. Suggest synthetic /24 + canary tenant + 30m traffic probe. ETA: harness in 5 days.

case-csm: Ill coordinate Kepler maintenance window and request BGP logs for validation. Will confirm slot by EOD tomorrow.

Owen P.: Preflight snippet for staging check:
```
# show bgp neighbors on staging-edge
ssh ops@staging-edge 'vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors"'
```

Maya S.: Local churn sim for test-router:
```
# transient withdraw sim
for i in 1 2 3; do ip route add 198.51.100.0/24 via 192.0.2.$i; sleep 10; ip route del 198.51.100.0/24; done
```

Nina R.: Prioritization: RDW-3051 (controller debounce) = prio:critical, RDW-3050 = prio:high. Hotfix should land before any mass isolation policy changes.

rdw-bot: Calendar invite "Kepler peering remediation sync" scheduled at 2301127200. Invitees: @Owen P., @Maya S., @Ravi (runtime), @case-csm, @Nina R.

Owen P.: Note: prefer dampening + targeted keepalive; avoid changing global hold-times.

Maya S.: Agreed — debounce + origin checks first, then canary.

Nina R.: Confirm owners & ETAs here by EOD. If any blocker, flag now.

Owen P.: Confirmed RDW-3050 owner, ETA design+staging 6 days.
Maya S.: Confirmed RDW-3051 owner, ETA hotfix 3 business days.
Ravi (runtime): Confirmed RDW-3052 (canary harness) ETA 5 days once tickets created.

Nina R.: Thanks everyone. I'll update the postmortem and add a monthly peering-stability check for Kepler. If anything changes, update the Jira ticket and ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
